name: How long does a full interior paint project take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full interior paint project take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full interior paint project for an average-sized home typically takes between 3 to 7 working days. The timeline varies based on prep requirements, such as repairing drywall damage, applying primer to dark colors, and waiting for coats to dry. Having our owner-led crew handle both finish repairs and painting keeps the schedule tight and predictable. If we are coordinating alongside other updates like baseboard installation or kitchen remodeling, we phase the painting so ceiling and wall work finishes before final flooring or trim detailing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most full interior paint jobs take 3 to 7 days, depending on home size, surface prep, drying times, and whether trim or ceiling repairs are included.
